title: Constructive code-projector decompositions and joint residual cancellation
summary: Character projectors, weight enumerators, and a checked random-code rule give an exact expected O*(phi^m) decomposition construction in the resource count.
content: Character projectors, weight enumerators, and a checked random-code rule give an exact expected O*(phi^m) decomposition construction in the resource count. Saved 14-, 41-, and 947-term identities illustrate cancellation across corrections. Their finite improvements do not establish a better asymptotic rate; lower bounds for uncombined recursion do not cover combined corrections.
whenToUse: Constructing exact tensor expansions from binary code projectors and combining residual corrections.
limitations: The expected bound is in the resource count. Finite identities do not improve the asymptotic guarantee; an uncombined-recursion lower bound does not cover joint cancellation.
